info.title: Wesog API
info.description:
The Wesog API lets your program search your Library, upload and organise files, run AI tools on images and videos, and run your workflows.

**Base address:** `https://api-platform.wesog.com/api/v1`

**Authentication:** send your API key in the `X-API-Key` header on every call. Create keys in *Current tenant settings > General > API keys*.

**Errors:** every error has the same shape: `code`, `message` and `request_id`. Quote the `request_id` when you contact support.

**Limits:** each key has a limit of requests per minute and per month, shown in the `RateLimit-*` headers; when it is reached you get `429` with `Retry-After`.

**Safe retries:** send an `Idempotency-Key` header on the calls that create or launch something.

post.description:
The address an AI agent connects to (MCP, Streamable HTTP). Do not call it by hand: give `https://api-platform.wesog.com/api/v1/mcp` to ChatGPT, Claude or your agent. Web assistants sign you in with your account; programs authenticate with an API key that has the `mcp` scope.

**Key scope:** a key without scopes can call it; a key with scopes needs one of: `mcp`.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST 'https://api-platform.wesog.com/api/v1/mcp' \
  -H 'X-API-Key: $WESOG_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list"}'

x-codeSamples.source:
import os, requests

url = "https://api-platform.wesog.com/api/v1/mcp"

payload = {"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list"}
response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.status_code, response.text[:500] if response.status_code == 204 else response.json())

get.description:
Returns all the stored data of one file: title, caption, keywords, people, place, dates and technical fields. `source_table` and `row_id` come from a search result (`source_table` and `entity_id`) or from an upload (`source_table` and `resource_id`). Use `fields` to ask only for some.

**Key scope:** a key without scopes can call it; a key with scopes needs one of: `search`, `read`, `library`.

patch.description:
The key needs the `library` scope explicitly (a key without scopes cannot). Changes the data of a file (headline, caption, keywords, place...). Send only the fields to change; the others stay as they are. Returns the file as it is now. The names of the fields are the ones of your Library (see the fields `GET` returns); an unknown field is refused with `unknown_library_fields`. A change is searchable within a few seconds.

**Key scope:** a key without scopes can call it; a key with scopes needs one of: `library`.

post.description:
Searches the photos, videos and documents of your organization with a natural-language `query` (people, places, dates, what is in the image). With an empty `query` it lists the Library, newest first. Page with `limit` and `offset`: when `next_offset` is present there are more results.

Every search counts towards your plan's monthly searches.

**Key scope:** a key without scopes can call it; a key with scopes needs one of: `search`, `read`, `library`.

post.description:
Uploads one file to your Library as `multipart/form-data`: the file in `file` and its destination path in `relative_path` (for example `events/2026/IMG_0412.jpg`). The file is indexed so it can be searched within minutes. Bigger files go in parts (see *Start a large upload*): over the limit the API answers `413`. Uploading to an existing path replaces the file.

**Key scope:** a key without scopes can call it; a key with scopes needs one of: `library`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value you choose (a UUID) for this operation. If you repeat the call with the same key within 24 hours you get the first answer again instead of running it twice. Sending the same key with a different body is an error (`409`).

x-codeSamples.source:

  -H 'X-API-Key: $WESOG_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: 6f1c2a9e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' \
  -F 'file=@IMG_0412.jpg' \
  -F 'relative_path=events/2026/madrid/IMG_0412.jpg'
